findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.sink: sendto(client_socket, buffer, strlen(buffer) + 1, 0, (const struct sockaddr *)&server_addr, sizeof(server_addr))
findings.trigger: An attacker could input a specially crafted string that, when received by the server, triggers an OS command execution.
findings.assumptions: The server processes incoming data by executing it as a command.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.sink: sendto(client_socket, buffer, strlen(buffer) + 1, 0, (const struct sockaddr *)&server_addr, sizeof(server_addr))
findings.trigger: An attacker could input a string longer than BUFFER_SIZE (258 bytes) to overflow the buffer.
findings.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed and the input is not properly validated.
